node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-one constant-color exclusion
node.statement: Both quadratic trace gcds from the h=15 constant-color reduction are unit over F_8191. Direct lower-factor values and primitive-quartic pseudo-remainders with terminal residues 4509 and 4947 exclude every sixteenth-root trace, closing the complete constant-color chamber.
node.notes: Complete proof close of the h=15 constant-color stratum. Combined with the degree barrier, live h=15 color degrees are four through thirteen; cyclotomic and inner conditions remain open.
